site.title: Panorama — a student community where knowledge creates impact
site.description: The official website of Panorama, a student volunteer community at the Syrian Private University connecting knowledge, service, and impact.

footer.description: Panorama is a student volunteer community that began at the Syrian Private University to connect knowledge, service, and impact through one principle: فيد واستفيد.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: An introductory privacy statement for the Panorama team website.
paragraphs: This is an introductory privacy statement for the Panorama informational website, not a substitute for a final legal policy. It must be reviewed and approved before any service collects personal or student data.
At this stage, the website introduces the team, its communities, and available contact methods. The visible forms are static interfaces and do not submit data to a backend service.

Do not send student records, verification documents, passwords, or payment information through this website. If you contact us by email, we may use the details you provide to answer your request and retain a practical record of that correspondence.
Interface-preference tools, such as theme or language selection, may store local preferences in your browser. This version does not present configured Panorama analytics or marketing cookies.

Before any digital service is launched, the final policy must explain what information is collected, why it is collected, how it is protected, how long it is retained, and how privacy or support requests can be raised.

terms.label: Terms
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Introductory terms for using the Panorama team website.
paragraphs: These are introductory terms for the Panorama informational website, not a complete legal agreement. They should be reviewed by qualified counsel before the final public launch.

The website introduces the Panorama team, its communities, student services, and ways to contact it. It does not currently provide user accounts, payments, access to administrative systems, or active online applications.

Please use content and contact methods lawfully and respectfully, and respect the team’s content and visual-identity rights. Do not represent information as official or approved unless Panorama publishes it through its configured channels.
Each service or initiative is presented according to its documented availability. Future paths and static form interfaces are not promises of availability, acceptance, or response time.
Any future digital services, joining forms, or institutional agreements will have separate approved terms and policies.
